observedFailure: anchor-loss fixture owner did not exit within 15 seconds
priorCasesPassed: normal EOF with stable waitable child and authoritative drain
location: fixture/Program.cs PosixOwner: Console.In.ReadLineAsync evaluated before Task.WhenAny
cause: Console.In is a synchronized TextReader; its async read may execute the blocking read synchronously. The fixture controller therefore could not race input against the native child-exit monitor.
correction: Run each console control read on a separate task before racing it with the waitid monitor.
retryJustification: Diagnosed fixture scheduling defect, fresh source snapshot and new attempt. No topology fallback or unsupported pass.
